description.zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
description.en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required when you authenticate with an Alibaba Cloud access key (AK/SK) or Security Token Service (STS).

description.zh: 是否包含个人的私有组
description.en: Specifies whether to include personal private groups in the results.

description.zh:
排序字段，仅有更新时间和创建时间的排序，默认为按照更新时间排序
- 更新时间：updated_at
- 创建时间：created_at
description.en:
The field to sort the results by. The default is `updated_at`.

- `updated_at`: Sorts by update time.

- `created_at`: Sorts by creation time.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The organization ID. You can find this ID in your organization's URL on the Alibaba Cloud DevOps platform, for example: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

description.zh:
页码 
默认值为1，从第1页开始
description.en: The page number. The default is `1`.

description.zh:
每页大小
默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
description.en: The page size. The value must be between 1 and 100. The default is `20`.

description.zh:
父路径的namespaceId
- 若查询所有组，那么该值为企业所对应的namespaceId（非organizationId）
- 若查询某个组下的所有组，那么该值为组所对应的namespaceId
description.en:
The ID of the parent namespace.

- To list all groups in the organization, set this parameter to the namespace ID of the organization (not the `organizationId`).

- To list all subgroups within a specific group, set this parameter to the namespace ID of that group.

description.zh:
排序方式，默认为desc
- desc：降序
- asc：升序
description.en:
The sort order. The default is `desc`.

- `desc`: Descending

- `asc`: Ascending
